text:
arjun: Quick check — seeing a bunch of `stream reset` errors when cancelling contexts for streaming responses from our Go client (Go 1.20). Example:

```go
req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "GET", url, nil)
resp, err := client.Do(req)
if err != nil { return err }
scanner := bufio.NewScanner(resp.Body)
for scanner.Scan() {
    // process
    if ctx.Err() != nil { break }
}
resp.Body.Close()
```

After cancelling the ctx the server logs H2 stream resets and we see transient errors on the next requests. Anyone bumped into this or have a recommended transport tuning?

sophia: Can you paste your http.Transport config? sometimes MaxIdle/IdleConnTimeout interplay matters for HTTP/2.

arjun: Sure — using a shared transport: 

```go
tr := &http.Transport{
  MaxIdleConns: 100,
  MaxIdleConnsPerHost: 100,
  IdleConnTimeout: 30*time.Second,
  TLSHandshakeTimeout: 10*time.Second,
  ExpectContinueTimeout: 1*time.Second,
}
client := &http.Client{Transport: tr}
```

We call `resp.Body.Close()` after break. But still see reset and connection being reused in a bad state.

liam: Two quick things we've seen:
- Make sure you fully drain or close the body before returning; Close should be enough but H2 can be finicky if the stream is mid-body. 
- Try calling `tr.CloseIdleConnections()` on cancel as a workaround (forces a fresh connection), or set `MaxConnsPerHost` to limit reuse.

nora: Another option — use `golang.org/x/net/http2`'s ConfigureTransport to make H2 behavior explicit. Also instrument with `net/http/httptrace` to see if connections are reused after cancel.

arjun: Nice — can you show the ConfigureTransport line?

sophia: 

```go
import "golang.org/x/net/http2"
http2.ConfigureTransport(tr)
```

Also consider bumping `IdleConnTimeout` a bit and `MaxConnsPerHost` so cancelled streams don't immediately get picked up by new requests.

arjun: I tried `tr.CloseIdleConnections()` when ctx canceled and that seems to stop the resets. Curious if that's safe perf-wise if we do it only when streaming requests are cancelled.

liam: It's heavier but OK as a targeted mitigation. Better add it only on the streaming cancellation path, not globally.

ci-bot: Link to internal note: https://redwood.internal/confluence/eng/runtime/http2-streams — add details and follow-up.

arjun: Opening an issue + PR to add CloseIdleConnections on cancel + include httptrace logs and config flags. Will post back results. Thanks y'all :thumbsup:
